lines: •Invested $151.2 million of capital during the third quarter of 2026, bringing the year-to-date total to $412.8 million and on track to meet 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $550 - $600 million.

The Company affirms its 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $550 - $600 million, driven primarily by increases in its regulated transmission (including initial investments in FEP), distribution and infrastructure investments.
For the five-year period ended 2028, the Company expects total capital investment to exceed $2.2 billion.
The Company also continues to reaffirm its 2028 earnings guidance of $7.75 - $8.00 per share.
